incident: Fake Zoom Ends in BlackSuit Ransomware (TTR ~194 hours / 9 days)

sources.title: Fake Zoom Ends in BlackSuit Ransomware - The DFIR Report (2025-03-31)
sources.what_it_gave: entry (fake Zoom installer -> d3f@ck/IDAT loader -> SectopRAT), hops (CS jump psexec_psh to DC + hosts, QDoor proxy RDP to file server + DC via DC/backup), cred access (LSASS via CS beacon), exfil (WinRAR to Bublup cloud ~934MB), impact (BlackSuit 123.exe via PsExec COPY.bat/EXE.bat + WMIC on DC), TTR ~194h

narrative_before: In a May 2024 intrusion the DFIR Report observed a fake Zoom website deliver an Inno Setup installer (d3f@ck loader) that pulled stages via a Steam Community page, ran the real Zoom installer as a decoy, and injected SectopRAT into MSBuild.exe (C2 IP from Pastebin); activity then ceased for eight days. On day nine SectopRAT spawned a Brute Ratel 'Badger' which ran discovery and launched a Cobalt Strike beacon (injected into dllhost, accessed LSASS). The actor moved laterally with Cobalt Strike jump psexec_psh, launching a PowerShell beacon on a domain controller and more hosts. On a DC and a backup server they dropped svhost.exe (QDoor proxy) and ran it via WMIC to tunnel RDP; using that tunnel they RDPed to a file share server (WinRAR archived shares), exfiltrated the archives to the Bublup SaaS cloud (~934MB), then RDPed to the first DC and fetched a RAR (123.exe/PsExec/comps[1-4].txt/COPY.bat/EXE.bat) from temp.sh. COPY.bat distributed BlackSuit (123.exe) via PsExec and EXE.bat executed it (vssadmin shadow deletion); the DC was encrypted last via WMIC. TTR was ~194 hours over nine days.

detection_moments.description: Fake Zoom installer -> d3f@ck/IDAT loader -> SectopRAT injected into MSBuild.exe; 8 days dormant.
detection_moments.evidence: 'installing a malicious program created with Inno Setup ... resulted in the injection of SectopRAT into MSBuild.exe ... activity ceased for eight days' - Fake Zoom, The DFIR Report

detection_moments.description: Day 9: Brute Ratel + Cobalt Strike (LSASS); jump psexec_psh PowerShell beacon on a DC and more hosts; QDoor proxy dropped on DC and backup server.
detection_moments.evidence: 'moving laterally using Cobalt Strike psexec_psh to launch a remote service for a PowerShell Cobalt beacon on a domain controller ... dropped a binary svhost.exe ... QDoor ... proxied RDP traffic' - Fake Zoom

detection_moments.description: QDoor-tunneled RDP to a file share server; WinRAR archives shares and ~934MB exfiltrated to Bublup cloud.
detection_moments.evidence: 'connected to a file share server where they used the Edge browser to download WinRAR ... exfiltrated these archives using the SaaS project management suite Bublup ... 934.38 MB was transferred' - Fake Zoom

detection_moments.description: ~194h: RAR with 123.exe/PsExec/COPY.bat/EXE.bat fetched to a DC; COPY.bat distributes BlackSuit via PsExec, EXE.bat runs it (vssadmin), DC encrypted via WMIC.
detection_moments.evidence: 'COPY.BAT ... distributed the BlackSuit ransomware payload named 123.exe to multiple remote hosts using PsExec ... used WMIC on their staging domain controller, to execute the ransomware a final time' - Fake Zoom

attack_path: fake Zoom installer -> d3f@ck/IDAT loader -> SectopRAT into MSBuild.exe (T1204.002/T1055)
Cobalt Strike jump psexec_psh PowerShell beacon on a domain controller (T1021.002/T1569.002)
QDoor-tunneled RDP to file share server; WinRAR archive + Bublup exfil (T1021.001/T1567.002)
COPY.bat/EXE.bat distribute and run BlackSuit via PsExec; DC encrypted via WMIC (T1486/T1490)
ambiguities: Hosts named by role only; victim sector not stated. Remote hosts reached by PsExec modelled as srv_1/pc_2.
QDoor proxy dropped on a DC and a backup server; link dc->srv_backup models the proxy relationship.
Moments are the report's own timeline markers (loader, day-9 lateral, exfil, encryption), not a defender detection timeline.
